responsibility: Implements the rs6000 RTL optimization pass for PC-relative external-symbol accesses. It scans use-def chains for a load of an external symbol’s address followed by exactly one eligible load or store in the same basic block, checks intervening instructions for safety, and rewrites the pair into special PCREL_OPT RTL forms with relocation markers so assembler/linker relaxation can collapse them into a single prefixed PC-relative memory instruction when possible.
